score_reasons.quality: High-detail guochao collage with crisp edges, rich fabric and architectural textures, clean typography; the invented glass walkway over the lake is structurally ambiguous and a few tiny scene signboards are only partially legible.
score_reasons.aesthetics: Excellent: bright white textured negative space, a sweeping red-silk S-curve unifying the layout, balanced title block on the left and the dancing figure anchoring the right; colorful yet harmonious, strong poster hierarchy.
score_reasons.alignment: Most required content is present and readable: SPRING 2026, vertical Beijing, 北京 seal, 【北京】 title, red silk S-composition from lower right to upper left, woman in Beijing-flavored embroidered red dress waving silk, Temple of Heaven, Great Wall, Bird's Nest, and a xiangsheng folk trio. However the canvas is square, not vertical 9:16; the primeval forest park appears only as generic trees with no recognizability; and Shichahai is rendered as a lake with a non-existent glass structure rather than its real identity.
score_reasons.real_world_fidelity: Temple of Heaven, Great Wall and Bird's Nest are instantly recognizable and reasonably accurate; costume and street-folk elements fit Beijing culture; the invented lakeside structure and unidentifiable greenery slightly weaken the city-identity requirement.
score_reasons.creative_generation: The silk-transforms-into-city-scroll device is elegant and suggests strong series consistency without duplication; information layers (title block, collage, figure) are well ordered and camera-like focus guides the eye.

unfulfilled_requirements: Vertical 9:16 format not met (canvas is square)
喇叭沟门原始森林公园 represented only as generic trees, not identifiable
什刹海 rendered with an invented glass walkway structure, weak real-world recognizability
